source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 29:1 binds Hebrew 28:69; public 29:2–29 binds Hebrew 29:1–28. All other public verses in chapters 27–34 align directly. All 266 original XML records, including written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves the name-called-over image instead of replacing it solely with ownership language.
Keeps the unannounced shift to divine first person rather than harmonizing me to him.
Follows the pinned sword reading among difficult affliction terms and retains all seven items.
Uses the recorded read form for hemorrhoids, with the written tumor term documented in a note.
Preserves sexual violence in the written verb rather than allowing the euphemistic read form to obscure harm.
Uses a cautious insect designation for the uncertain chirring pest while retaining the dispossession verb.
Retains the fruit image and explicitly names the cannibalism rather than softening the harm.
Makes the withholding explicit while preserving the repeated siege cause and child victims.
Preserves afterbirth, childbirth, secrecy, and cannibalism without euphemizing the siege’s horror.
Preserves the unsettling repeated divine rejoicing and the uprooting rather than explaining them away.
Keeps ships, the reversed return prohibition, both slave sexes, and unsuccessful self-sale.
